root_cause: Use of blended pricing instead of interchange‑plus pricing.
diagnosis: The blended rate of 2.0% applied to Rs 3,355,280.42 yields fees of Rs 67,105.61, exceeding the true network cost of Rs 61,210.45 (effective true rate 1.82%) by Rs 5,895.16; this overcharge assessment uses a modeled benchmark because the source status is illustrative.
action_rationale: Switching to interchange‑plus aligns fees with actual network costs, removing the blended‑rate spread.
